component.name: PI-Desktop
component.summary: Local-first desktop workspace for AI agents

description.p: This is a community package of PI-Desktop, maintained independently and unaffiliated with PI-Desktop or its author. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

PI-Desktop is a local-first desktop workspace for AI agents: projects, sessions, models, plugins and workflows live in one persistent environment, with no mandatory account and no telemetry. Models are a replaceable component — cloud providers, open-compatible gateways, or local runtimes such as Ollama and LM Studio.

ul.li: Persistent projects and sessions that survive app restarts.
Switch provider, model and reasoning level per session.
Delegate to subagents or coordinate parallel worker sessions.
Plugins add panels, views, agent tools, MCP servers, themes and background services.

description.p: Permissions: this package keeps a tight sandbox by default — network, display, GPU, audio playback and notifications. Credentials are kept in the app's own encrypted store inside the per-app data directory and file picking goes through the desktop portal; no broad filesystem access is granted. The app's own state directory (sessions, provider credentials, window state) is kept in the per-app data directory, so it persists across launches while staying inside the sandbox. Commands the agent runs execute inside the sandbox with the runtime's own shell and core tools — this package does not bridge the sandbox out to host tools.
A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Open projects stored anywhere in your home directory (and let session import see your real ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.pi and similar directories): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home net.aiuo.pi-desktop

Keep custom prompts, skills and MCP servers in the shared agent directories ~/.pi and ~/.agents (created if missing; without this they reset on each launch): flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/.pi --filesystem=~/.agents net.aiuo.pi-desktop
Microphone access for voice plugins: flatpak override --user --device=all net.aiuo.pi-desktop
Let the system keyring (GNOME Keyring / KWallet) encrypt the stored credentials: flatpak override --user --talk-name=org.freedesktop.secrets net.aiuo.pi-desktop
